title: Show maximal strictly improving circuit steps can halve the exact gap forever
statement: For A=[[1,2,1,0],[2,1,0,1]],b=(1,1),c=(1,1,0,0),x0=(1/2,0,1/2,0), alternate support-minimal kernel directions(-2,1,0,3) and(1,-2,3,0) with maximal feasible steps. Every step strictly improves but c^T xk=2^(-(k+1))>0 for finite k, while optimum(0,0,1,1) has value0 and a one-step circuit route exists. A zeroed coordinate is revived at the next step.
